import pathlib,binascii
for p in ['libidn2/fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.repro']+ [str(x) for x in pathlib.Path('gnutls/fuzz/gnutls_idna_parser_fuzzer.in').iterdir()]:

        data=pp.read_bytes()
